steps: A recipe-only project lists its ordinary JSON document in the preview picker, renders four generated instances/groups and frozen images, and exposes fragment/placement identities. Scene editing is blocked and the build tab contains no recipe or executable job.

A clean source editor enters one selected instance override without requiring a dummy dirty edit. The form shows local position before its placement offset and named registered images. Cancel preserves source text, save baseline, metadata and image bytes.

Six changed fields are checked through real Rust and the preview service, reviewed as complete author text and applied only to editor memory. Shared fragment, stable identities, first placement and all saved files remain unchanged. Chinese, English and Japanese390px forms retain the approved source and fit the window.
A newer source edit made after review invalidates the pending override application. The later text is retained, old approval cannot overwrite it, and no file has yet been saved.

Only normal editor Save persists the override source. Reopened saved preview preserves the exact author SHA, generated result and UUIDs. Only the recipe document changes; metadata/images remain identical and direct executable build capture still rejects recipes.

An external file change after review is never overwritten by local application. Ordinary Save reports its original-baseline conflict; cancel keeps the overridden draft and external bytes, without a force write.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
Single-instance six-field set in an existing recipe source session; no template editing, deletion/reset, graph writeback or executable recipe build.
